questions.subject: SPANISH
questions.topic: The feminine of a profession in -ado across varieties

questions.subject: SPANISH
questions.topic: Nouns in -ista and the gender of the person named
questions.learningObjective: Explain that -ista nouns are common gender
questions.stem: Explain why a dispatcher writes 'la artista' and 'el artista'.

answer.exemplar: Nouns in -ista are common gender, so the same form artista is used for both men and women, and only the article changes.

questions.explanation: -ista nouns do not change form by gender. The article indicates the person's gender.

questions.topic: Forming an adverb in -mente from an adjective

stimulus.body: A dispatcher writes a log entry describing how a train arrived. The adjective used is 'rápido', and the adverb form must be chosen.

questions.explanation: Adverbs in -mente are formed from the feminine form of the adjective: rápidamente. Using the masculine form is not standard.

questions.topic: Replacing muy before an adverb or a longer adjective
questions.stem: A log entry says 'muy rápidamente'; which replacement is preferred?

options.misconception: uses a comparative instead of superlative

questions.explanation: Before an adverb, muy can be replaced by a superlative form. Rapidísimamente is the careful choice.
